title: Combinatorics
description: Merge shapes with union, subtract, intersect and more: arm a mode and draw over an existing shape, or combine a selection on the spot.

bubble.title: Combinatorics: shapes that merge
bubble.body: Combinatorics merges shapes into new ones — union joins them, subtract cuts one out of another. Arm a mode in this section, and the next shape you draw over an existing one combines with it as it lands.

bubble.title: Watch: union, then subtract
bubble.body: Press Watch demo: the program draws a rectangle, arms Union and draws over it so the two merge, then arms Subtract and cuts a bite out.

demo.title: A first rectangle
demo.body: Drawing a plain rectangle. No mode is armed yet.

demo.title: Union armed
demo.body: Arming Union in the Combinatorics section. The next overlapping shape merges on deposit.

demo.title: Merged
demo.body: The second rectangle landed overlapping the first, and the two are now one shape.

demo.title: Subtract armed
demo.body: Arming Subtract. The next overlapping shape cuts its overlap away.

demo.title: A bite taken
demo.body: The overlap is cut out of the merged shape.

demo.title: Mode off
demo.body: Back to None — plain drawing again. Modes stay armed until you switch them off.

bubble.title: Arm Union yourself
bubble.body: In the Combinatorics section, choose Union. The mode stays armed for the next shape you draw.

bubble.title: Draw over a shape
bubble.body: Steer so your rectangle will overlap an existing shape, and press I to start it.

bubble.title: Deposit the union
bubble.body: Steer and press I again. Because Union is armed and the shapes overlap, the new rectangle merges into the one it covers.

bubble.title: Now arm Subtract
bubble.body: Choose Subtract in the Combinatorics section.

bubble.title: Draw the cutter
bubble.body: Steer so this rectangle will overlap the merged shape, and press I to start it.

bubble.title: Deposit the cut
bubble.body: Steer and press I again. The overlap is cut out of the shape underneath.

bubble.title: Two ways to combine
bubble.body: Modes work two ways: armed, they combine the next shape you draw over another — and with two or more shapes selected, choosing a mode combines the selection immediately. Choose None in the section to return to plain drawing.
